parameters.content:
## 03 Facebook Lead Ads Sync

Meta Lead Ads webhook to a validated, deduped CRM record with an instant first reply.

**Safety rails:** Calls 16-safety-rails before any outbound action.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

nodes.name: FB Lead Webhook
nodes.notes: Subscribe the page to the leadgen field in your Meta app.

nodes.name: Verify Payload
nodes.notes: Signature verification itself belongs in a reverse proxy or the Webhook node's auth - this node only rejects structurally invalid payloads.

nodes.name: Reject Invalid Payload
nodes.notes: Dead end. Do not create leads from unverified payloads.

nodes.name: Safety Rails
nodes.notes: Calls 16-safety-rails. Nothing that can reach a prospect runs before the rails return allowed=true.

nodes.name: Rails Allowed?
nodes.notes: False branch is a dead end by design.

parameters.query:
=SELECT id FROM leads
WHERE email_key = lower(nullif('{{ $json.lead.email }}', ''))
   OR phone_key = right(regexp_replace(nullif('{{ $json.lead.phone }}', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10)
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: CRM Upsert
nodes.notes: One HTTP node, one mapping node. Swap CRM by changing CRM_BASE_URL, the credential and CRM_ADAPTER. See docs/CRM-MAPPING.md.

nodes.name: Send Instant Reply
nodes.notes: Speed matters more than polish here. Keep it to one short message with a booking link.

meta.purpose: Meta Lead Ads webhook to a validated, deduped CRM record with an instant first reply.
